this is Lemma 4.2 (shifted tripling) of the paper at (a,h)=(2,1): P(2,4) >= 3 P(2,1) after Cor. 3.2
scope: Finite exact identity for the stated parameters only. It does not by itself establish the identity for other parameters, nor the tensor-character inequality, which needs Lemma 2.3 (interpolation, characteristic zero) and Corollary 3.2 of the paper.
